title: Endurancecraft
description: This mod shows the durability of tools, which leads to strong gameplay.
body:
The mod adds a durability counter for tools. This simplifies gameplay. There's also a "/dur" command to remove durability if it's interfering at any point. However, keep in mind that you won't see the durability if you do! To restore it, use the same command. 
**This mod is in alpha, so there may be some bugs!**
